title: China-to-Colombia Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Colombia assesses power-tool electrical safety primarily against NTC standards that adopt IEC, notably NTC/IEC 62841 for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden tools, with conformity demonstrated through an ONAC-accredited certification body and a Certificate of Conformity. The RETIE technical regulation (Resolucion 40117 of 2024 and updates) governs electrical products and installations and applies where the tool, its charger, or its supply is wired into or forms part of an electrical installation; products designed for 110/220 V 60 Hz must be evaluated for the Colombian grid rather than China's 220/380 V 50 Hz.
target_standards: NTC/IEC 62841 series (ICONTEC NTC adopting IEC 62841) for power-tool safety
RETIE technical regulation (Reglamento Tecnico de Instalaciones Electricas), Resolucion 40117 of 2024 and subsequent updates, where the tool or supply is part of an electrical installation
Conformity assessment via ONAC-accredited certification body with Certificate of Conformity (Certificado de Conformidad)
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly rely on the GB/T 3883 series (hand-held motor-operated electric tools) as the domestic baseline, with CCC where applicable and separate charger evidence for cordless models. GB/T 3883 reports are built around China's 220 V 50 Hz environment and do not by themselves provide a Colombian Certificate of Conformity or RETIE evaluation.
china_standards: China charger safety evidence for cordless models where applicable
rows.gap: A common gap is presenting a GB/T 3883 report at China voltage and frequency as sufficient for Colombia. The exporter must obtain NTC/IEC 62841 conformity through an ONAC-accredited body and a Certificate of Conformity, evaluate the product at 110/220 V 60 Hz, and screen whether RETIE applies to the charger, supply, or installation interface.

target.en: Mandatory: product safety conformity assessment to adopted NTC/IEC 62841 with a Certificate of Conformity from an ONAC-accredited body, and RETIE compliance where the product is wired into or forms part of an electrical installation. The underlying IEC technical standards are the conformity route; the technical regulation and certificate obligation are the mandatory legal layer.
target.zh: 强制：按采用的 NTC/IEC 62841 进行产品安全符合性评定，并由 ONAC 认可机构出具符合性证书；在产品接入电气装置或构成其一部分时须满足 RETIE。底层 IEC 技术标准是符合性路径，技术规章和证书义务是强制法律层。
target.zht: 強制：按採用的 NTC/IEC 62841 進行產品安全符合性評定，並由 ONAC 認可機構出具符合性證書；在產品接入電氣裝置或構成其一部分時須滿足 RETIE。底層 IEC 技術標準是符合性路徑，技術規章和證書義務是強制法律層。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where the product category is in CCC scope.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，产品类别在 CCC 范围内时加 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，產品類別在 CCC 範圍內時加 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Colombia-ready while the file rests only on GB/T 3883 China-voltage evidence. Conformity to adopted NTC/IEC 62841 via an ONAC-accredited body with a Certificate of Conformity, 110/220 V 60 Hz evaluation, and a RETIE applicability screen for the supply or installation interface are needed before market placement.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Minas y Energia de Colombia (RETIE)

rows.target_requirement: Colombia does not operate a single horizontal EMC marking directive like the EU; electromagnetic behavior is addressed mainly through adopted NTC/IEC product safety standards and, for tools with any radio function, through spectrum and equipment rules administered by the CRC (Comision de Regulacion de Comunicaciones) and the ANE (Agencia Nacional del Espectro). Cordless tools that include wireless connectivity, Bluetooth, or radio remotes require homologation or authorization of the radio module under CRC/ANE rules in addition to product-safety conformity.
target_standards: CRC (Comision de Regulacion de Comunicaciones) equipment and homologation rules for radio-enabled devices
ANE (Agencia Nacional del Espectro) spectrum rules for the relevant frequency bands
Adopted NTC/IEC product standards addressing emissions/immunity within the safety conformity package where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC test reports referenced to GB/T standards alongside GB/T 3883 safety, and SRRC type approval for radio modules used domestically. China EMC and SRRC evidence is structured for the China market and does not substitute for Colombian CRC/ANE radio authorization or for emission/immunity coverage of the actual exported configuration.
china_standards: China GB/T EMC test reports where applicable
SRRC type approval for radio modules where applicable
rows.gap: The frequent gap is assuming China EMC or SRRC evidence transfers directly. Radio-enabled cordless tools need CRC/ANE homologation or authorization for the Colombian bands, and the in-country importer typically holds or supports that authorization; EMC behavior should be covered for the exact marketed tool, charger, and controller configuration.

target.en: Mandatory for radio-enabled tools: CRC/ANE homologation or authorization of the radio function for Colombian spectrum. There is no single EU-style horizontal EMC marking directive; emission/immunity is handled within adopted NTC/IEC product standards and sector rules rather than a standalone CE-type EMC mark.
target.zh: 对带无线电工具强制：就哥伦比亚频谱取得无线电功能的 CRC/ANE 型号核准或授权。没有单一的欧盟式横向 EMC 标识指令；发射/抗扰在采用的 NTC/IEC 产品标准和行业规则内处理，而非独立的 CE 式 EMC 标识。
target.zht: 對帶無線電工具強制：就哥倫比亞頻譜取得無線電功能的 CRC/ANE 型號核准或授權。沒有單一的歐盟式橫向 EMC 標識指令；發射/抗擾在採用的 NTC/IEC 產品標準和行業規則內處理，而非獨立的 CE 式 EMC 標識。

cn.en: China domestic files may include GB/T EMC reports and SRRC type approval for radio modules where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 GB/T EMC 报告，并在适用时包含无线电模块的 SRRC 型号核准。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 GB/T EMC 報告，並在適用時包含無線電模組的 SRRC 型號核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For radio-enabled cordless tools, not Colombia-ready until the radio function holds CRC/ANE homologation or authorization for the Colombian bands and emission/immunity is covered for the actual exported configuration. Colombia has no standalone EU-style EMC marking, so do not present a CE EMC declaration as the local requirement.

rows.requirement: Colombian Market Access and Conformity Assessment
rows.target_requirement: Placing power tools on the Colombian market generally requires a Certificate of Conformity issued by an ONAC-accredited certification body against the applicable adopted NTC/IEC standard, and compliance with the relevant technical regulation (RETIE for electrical products wired into installations; RETILAP for lighting; RETIQ for energy labelling where applicable). The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) enforces these obligations and may verify certificates at the point of sale or import. An in-country importer or responsible economic operator is typically required, and goods clear through ports such as Cartagena and Buenaventura.
target_standards: Certificate of Conformity (Certificado de Conformidad) from an ONAC-accredited certification body against adopted NTC/IEC 62841
RETIE technical regulation for electrical products wired into installations; RETILAP for lighting; RETIQ for energy labelling where applicable
SIC (Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio) market enforcement and certificate verification
In-country importer / responsible economic operator requirement
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series and, where in scope, CCC certification as the domestic market-entry baseline. A GB/T 3883 report or CCC mark does not constitute a Colombian Certificate of Conformity, does not satisfy RETIE, and is not recognized by SIC as local conformity evidence on its own.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report or CCC mark is not enough for Colombian placement. The importer needs a Certificate of Conformity from an ONAC-accredited body against the adopted NTC/IEC standard, a RETIE applicability assessment, an established in-country importer, and Spanish-language documentation aligned to SIC enforcement and customs clearance.

target.en: Mandatory legal layer: Certificate of Conformity from an ONAC-accredited certification body plus applicable technical regulation (RETIE/RETILAP/RETIQ) compliance, enforced by SIC, with an in-country importer. Adopted NTC/IEC standards are the conformity-assessment basis.
target.zh: 强制法律层：由 ONAC 认可的认证机构出具符合性证书，并满足适用技术规章（RETIE/RETILAP/RETIQ），由 SIC 执法，且设有境内进口商。采用的 NTC/IEC 标准是符合性评定依据。
target.zht: 強制法律層：由 ONAC 認可的認證機構出具符合性證書，並滿足適用技術規章（RETIE/RETILAP/RETIQ），由 SIC 執法，且設有境內進口商。採用的 NTC/IEC 標準是符合性評定依據。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where the product is in CCC scope.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，产品在 CCC 范围内时加 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，產品在 CCC 範圍內時加 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Colombia-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence or a CCC mark. A Certificate of Conformity from an ONAC-accredited body, a RETIE applicability assessment, an in-country importer, and SIC-aligned Spanish documentation are required before placement.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), Colombia

rows.requirement: Noise Emissions and the Absence of an Outdoor-Noise Marking Regime
rows.target_requirement: Colombia does not operate an EU-style horizontal outdoor-equipment noise marking and conformity regime equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no guaranteed sound-power-level marking obligation tied to placing power tools on the market. Noise in Colombia is regulated mainly as an environmental and occupational matter through resolutions of the Ministerio de Ambiente (for example Resolucion 627 of 2006 on environmental noise standards) and occupational-health rules, which set ambient and workplace exposure limits rather than a product noise-marking certificate. Any product noise data usually comes from the adopted NTC/IEC tool standard's noise-measurement clauses rather than from a separate Colombian noise mark.
target_standards: Resolucion 627 of 2006 (Ministerio de Ambiente) on environmental noise standards and noise emission [ambient/environmental, not a product noise mark]
Occupational noise-exposure rules under Colombian occupational health and safety regulation [workplace exposure, not a product marking]
Noise-measurement clauses within adopted NTC/IEC 62841 where the tool standard includes them [product noise data, not a standalone mark]
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards, and tool noise/vibration data, where present, comes from the GB/T tool standard's measurement clauses. China likewise does not require an EU outdoor-noise marking, so neither side carries a guaranteed sound-power marking for general power tools.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series (noise/vibration measurement clauses where included)
China environmental and occupational noise rules where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, there is little product-marking gap here because Colombia has no EU-style outdoor-noise mark to satisfy. The real obligations are environmental and occupational noise limits at the point of use, plus any noise/vibration declaration the adopted tool standard or buyer requests. Exporters should not assume a CE 2000/14/EC noise mark is required, and should not assume its absence removes ambient/workplace noise-limit responsibilities in Colombia.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style outdoor-noise product marking exists in Colombia for power tools. Mandatory obligations are environmental noise limits (e.g., Resolucion 627 of 2006) and occupational noise-exposure limits at the point of use, which fall on operators and sites rather than as a placing-on-market product mark.
target.zh: 哥伦比亚对电动工具不存在欧盟式户外噪声产品标识的强制要求。强制义务是使用环节的环境噪声限值（如 2006 年第 627 号决议）和职业噪声暴露限值，由操作者和场所承担，而非投放市场的产品标识。
target.zht: 哥倫比亞對電動工具不存在歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識的強制要求。強制義務是使用環節的環境噪聲限值（如 2006 年第 627 號決議）和職業噪聲暴露限值，由操作者和場所承擔，而非投放市場的產品標識。

cn.en: China has no EU-style outdoor-noise product mark either; GB/T tool-standard noise clauses and environmental/occupational rules apply where relevant.
cn.zh: 中国同样没有欧盟式户外噪声产品标识；适用时适用 GB/T 工具标准噪声条款及环境/职业规则。
cn.zht: 中國同樣沒有歐盟式戶外噪聲產品標識；適用時適用 GB/T 工具標準噪聲條款及環境/職業規則。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style outdoor-noise marking applies in Colombia, so there is no product noise mark to obtain for power tools. Treat noise as an environmental and occupational limit at the point of use, and provide any noise/vibration data only where the adopted tool standard or buyer requires it; do not present a CE 2000/14/EC noise mark as a Colombian requirement.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, Colombia

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances and the Absence of a Horizontal RoHS Regime
rows.target_requirement: Colombia does not have an EU-style horizontal RoHS regime that restricts specific hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment as a placing-on-market condition for power tools. Chemical and hazardous-substance controls in Colombia are handled through environmental, chemical-management, and waste rules (for example WEEE-type electronic waste management under Law 1672 of 2013 and related Ministerio de Ambiente regulation) rather than a product substance-restriction declaration tied to market entry. There is therefore no mandatory RoHS-equivalent substance declaration required to place a tool on the Colombian market.
target_standards: Law 1672 of 2013 (Colombia) on management of electrical and electronic waste (RAEE/WEEE-type) and related Ministerio de Ambiente regulation [waste/environmental, not a product substance-restriction mark]
Colombian chemical-management and hazardous-substance environmental rules where applicable [no horizontal RoHS substance-declaration condition for market entry]
rows.china_equivalent: China operates China RoHS (administrative measures for restriction of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic products) with marking and declaration expectations, alongside GB/T 3883 safety. China RoHS material evidence can support buyer due diligence, but Colombia does not require a RoHS-equivalent product declaration for market placement.
china_standards: China RoHS (administrative measures for restricted substances in electrical and electronic products) where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, there is no RoHS market-entry gap to close in Colombia because there is no horizontal RoHS substance-restriction condition for placing power tools on the market. The relevant obligations are end-of-life electronic-waste management and general chemical/environmental rules. Exporters should keep any China RoHS or material data for buyer due diligence but should not assume a Colombian RoHS declaration is mandatory, nor assume its absence removes electronic-waste responsibilities.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style RoHS substance-restriction declaration for market entry in Colombia. Mandatory obligations are end-of-life electronic-waste management (Law 1672 of 2013 and related rules) and general chemical/environmental controls, not a product RoHS mark.
target.zh: 哥伦比亚市场准入不存在欧盟式 RoHS 物质限制声明的强制要求。强制义务是报废电子废弃物管理（2013 年第 1672 号法律及相关规则）和一般化学/环境管控，而非产品 RoHS 标识。
target.zht: 哥倫比亞市場准入不存在歐盟式 RoHS 物質限制聲明的強制要求。強制義務是報廢電子廢棄物管理（2013 年第 1672 號法律及相關規則）和一般化學/環境管控，而非產品 RoHS 標識。

cn.en: China RoHS marking/declaration applies to in-scope electrical and electronic products domestically; it does not transfer to Colombia as a market-entry condition.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 标识/声明在境内适用于范围内电气电子产品；不会作为市场准入条件转用于哥伦比亚。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 標識/聲明在境內適用於範圍內電氣電子產品；不會作為市場准入條件轉用於哥倫比亞。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No horizontal RoHS substance-restriction condition applies to placing power tools on the Colombian market, so there is no RoHS declaration to obtain. Treat substance/material data as buyer due-diligence material and address end-of-life electronic-waste obligations under Colombian RAEE/WEEE rules; do not present a CE RoHS declaration as a Colombian market-entry requirement.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, Colombia (RAEE/WEEE)

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Batteries and the Absence of an EU-Style Battery Regulation
rows.target_requirement: Colombia does not have a single horizontal battery regulation equivalent to EU Regulation 2023/1542 that imposes battery CE marking, removability, due diligence, and battery-passport duties as a market-entry condition. Lithium battery packs in cordless tools are governed mainly by transport safety rules (UN 38.3 for lithium-cell transport), any applicable adopted NTC/IEC cell/pack safety standard, and end-of-life battery and electronic-waste management. Used-battery management is addressed through environmental rules such as Resolucion 1297 of 2010 on the selective collection and environmental management of waste batteries.
target_standards: UN 38.3 (lithium battery transport testing) for shipment safety
Adopted NTC/IEC cell or pack safety standards where applicable to the battery
Resolucion 1297 of 2010 (Ministerio de Ambiente) on selective collection and environmental management of waste batteries [end-of-life, not an EU-style battery passport/CE regime]
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, supported by lithium-battery safety standards (such as GB 31241 for portable electronic-product lithium batteries) and UN 38.3 transport evidence. This China and transport evidence supports safety and shipping but is not an EU-style battery economic-operator and passport package, which Colombia also does not require.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series (battery pack tested with the tool)
GB 31241 lithium battery safety where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, there is no EU-style battery-regulation market-entry gap in Colombia because there is no battery CE marking, removability, due-diligence, or passport condition for placing cordless tools on the market. The real obligations are lithium transport safety, cell/pack safety, and end-of-life waste-battery management. Exporters should not assume an EU battery passport or battery CE mark is required, nor assume its absence removes UN 38.3 transport and used-battery collection responsibilities.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style battery CE/passport regime for market entry in Colombia. Mandatory obligations are lithium transport safety (UN 38.3), applicable adopted cell/pack safety standards, and end-of-life waste-battery management (e.g., Resolucion 1297 of 2010), not a battery placing-on-market mark.
target.zh: 哥伦比亚市场准入不存在欧盟式电池 CE/护照制度的强制要求。强制义务是锂电池运输安全（UN 38.3）、适用的采用电芯/电池包安全标准，以及报废废电池管理（如 2010 年第 1297 号决议），而非电池投放市场标识。
target.zht: 哥倫比亞市場准入不存在歐盟式電池 CE/護照制度的強制要求。強制義務是鋰電池運輸安全（UN 38.3）、適用的採用電芯/電池包安全標準，以及報廢廢電池管理（如 2010 年第 1297 號決議），而非電池投放市場標識。

cn.en: China battery safety (e.g., GB 31241) and UN 38.3 transport evidence apply to the pack; this does not constitute an EU-style battery economic-operator package and is not a Colombian market-entry condition.
cn.zh: 中国电池安全（如 GB 31241）和 UN 38.3 运输证据适用于电池包；这不构成欧盟式电池经济经营者包，也不是哥伦比亚市场准入条件。
cn.zht: 中國電池安全（如 GB 31241）和 UN 38.3 運輸證據適用於電池包；這不構成歐盟式電池經濟經營者包，也不是哥倫比亞市場准入條件。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style battery CE or battery-passport condition applies to placing cordless tools on the Colombian market, so there is no battery market-entry mark to obtain. Address lithium transport safety (UN 38.3), applicable cell/pack safety, and end-of-life waste-battery management instead; do not present an EU battery passport or battery CE mark as a Colombian requirement.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, Colombia (waste batteries, Resolucion 1297 of 2010)
